notes: Every PPPoE session on a port reported the same traffic: the counters were read from the physical port they all share, so each session was shown the whole port's total. They now count on their own ppp interface. The command log grew without limit and was the road to the disk-write error seen after bulk PPPoE work; it is now capped at the newest 2000 rows. Duplicating sessions in bulk redid the whole list's work every time -- creating 100 sessions cost about 15,150 file writes and 100 daemon-reloads, now 300 writes and one reload.
